attribution_html:
Unknown authorUnknown author, Public domain,

File origin - Namuwiki (https://namu.wiki/w/%EC%8B%A0%EC%82%AC%EC%9E%84%EB%8B%B9)

Purported portrait of Shin Saimdang (1504-1551) discovered in 1977. Featured on the March 1977 issue of the Weolgan Munhwajae. The portrait was first purchased by Hong Ki-dae, a pawn shop owner and collector of old Korean porcelains, around 1962 or 1963 from a Liberty Party member, according to Hong. The verifiability of the portrait is highly contested, as portraits of women during the Joseon dynasty were very rare. Source: Weekly Donga (https://weekly.donga.com/culture/article/all/11/525555/1)

Hong Ki-dae died in 2019. Source: Chosun Ilbo (https://www.chosun.com/site/data/html_dir/2019/03/27/2019032700067.html)

Other photos of the portrait featured on the 1977 Weolgan Munhwajae issue: (https://www.yetnal.co.kr/shop/item.php?it_id=1591617349&device=pc)
